title: Implement topological sort using Kahn's algorithm in Go
description: Implement topological sort (Kahn's BFS-based algorithm) on a directed acyclic graph. Return error if a cycle is detected.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement TopoSort using Kahn's algorithm:
1. Compute in-degree for every node; initialize queue with nodes of in-degree 0
2. While queue non-empty: dequeue node, append to result, for each neighbor decrement in-degree; if it reaches 0 enqueue it
3. If len(result) < len(graph): return nil, errors.New("cycle detected")
4. Return result, nil
Note: initialise all graph keys in in-degree map (including those with empty adjacency lists) so isolated nodes are included.
All 4 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
